title: Reports: traceability, quality extras, purchasing - info sheet entries

entries.title: Supplier lot number required on a purchase bill
entries.what_it_does: Makes the supplier's lot or batch number compulsory on every stock line before a purchase bill can be posted.
entries.why_it_matters: Without a lot number a bad delivery cannot be traced to the products and outlets it reached.
entries.what_changes_if_switched: A bill with a stock line and no lot number is refused at posting. Needs the server hook; the screen asks either way.

entries.title: Lot expiry date required
entries.what_it_does: Also requires the expiry date printed on the supplier's lot.
entries.why_it_matters: Expiry lists are silent about stock with no expiry.
entries.what_changes_if_switched: A stock line without an expiry date is refused at posting (together with the lot switch).

entries.title: Trace a batch
entries.what_it_does: Follows a batch from the supplier lot through production, transfers and sales to the outlets and named customers, and back.
entries.why_it_matters: Answers 'where did this lot go' in minutes.
entries.default: Always available to who may read stock or quality reports.
entries.what_changes_if_switched: Nothing changes. It only reads. Stock with no batch is printed as the unbatched quantity.
entries.who_can_change: Anyone with the stock or quality report right.

entries.title: Recall case
entries.what_it_does: Records a recall: the batches under recall, what was done with each, and prints the affected-stock report.
entries.why_it_matters: A recall needs one list of everything affected, and a record that it was handled.
entries.default: No case exists until someone opens one.
entries.what_changes_if_switched: Opening a case writes a red line in Exceptions. Holding, returning or writing off is done with the existing screens.
entries.who_can_change: The owner or the recall_manage right.

entries.title: Quality check with item, quantity, supplier
entries.what_it_does: A quality check can name the item, the quantity checked or rejected and the supplier.
entries.why_it_matters: Needed for the supplier rejection rate.
entries.default: Optional. Old checks stay blank and say 'data not captured'.
entries.what_changes_if_switched: Filters by item and supplier appear on the list.

entries.title: Damaged quantity on transfer receive
entries.what_it_does: The receiver can write how much of what arrived is damaged and why.
entries.why_it_matters: Separates damage from a short count.
entries.what_changes_if_switched: A yellow line appears in Exceptions. Stock is not changed: write damaged goods off with the wastage screen.

entries.title: Stockout log
entries.what_it_does: A simple shop entry: date, place, item, note, optional estimate of missed quantity.
entries.why_it_matters: Shows what customers asked for and the shop did not have.
entries.what_changes_if_switched: Nothing changes in stock or money. A blank estimate is never added as 0.
entries.who_can_change: The owner or the stockout_log right.

entries.title: Shelf life not set notice
entries.what_it_does: Lists made products that have no shelf-life rule.
entries.why_it_matters: Their batches get no expiry, so expiry lists say nothing about them.
entries.what_changes_if_switched: Set the rule in Settings > Shelf life.

entries.title: Actual yield at production
entries.what_it_does: An optional box in the production sheet for the real quantity made.
entries.why_it_matters: The report can then compare real and standard yield.
entries.default: Blank: the standard yield goes into stock and the run says 'actual yield not captured'.
entries.what_changes_if_switched: A typed value is what goes into stock for that run (existing production rule).

entries.title: Agreed price per item and supplier
entries.what_it_does: The price agreed with a supplier, from a date; a new price closes the old one.
entries.why_it_matters: Lets the price variance report show what was paid above the agreement.
entries.default: Blank. Lines with no agreed price are counted as 'not captured'.
entries.what_changes_if_switched: Nothing is posted or changed; it is a comparison.

entries.title: Preferred and alternative suppliers
entries.what_it_does: Which suppliers may supply an item, preferred or alternative.
entries.why_it_matters: Shows items that depend on one supplier.
entries.default: Blank. Items without a declared supplier are flagged 'not captured'.

entries.title: Purchasing reports
entries.what_it_does: Returns and adjustments, price variance, rejection rate, supplier dependency, delivery performance.
entries.default: Always available to who may read purchase reports.
entries.what_changes_if_switched: Read only. Money shown only with the cost right.
entries.who_can_change: Anyone with the purchase report right.
